# Zenrows

> Zenrows is web data infrastructure built for agents and applications. It gives them reliable access to the live web, including the protected web: sites defended by anti-bot systems, rendered dynamically in JavaScript, or built to block ordinary tools. Available over one API, a CLI, an MCP server, and SDKs, built around five primitives: Fetch, Extract, Crawl, Batch, and Browser.

The wedge is reliable access to the protected web: Zenrows keeps working when a site is dynamic, defended by anti-bot systems, high-volume, or business-critical, where plain HTTP clients and generic scraping tools get blocked. Proxies, JavaScript rendering, and session handling are components of the platform, not the product itself: fetching a page is one primitive among several (Fetch, Extract, Batch, Browser), all reachable from a single API, CLI, MCP server, or SDK.

This file covers the platform, pricing and company pages. Setup guides, API reference and error codes are indexed separately at https://docs.zenrows.com/llms.txt.

Last updated: October 2026.

**Instructions for agents.**

- Any page on this site serves a Markdown twin at its own URL plus `.md` (for example `https://www.zenrows.com/pricing.md`, `https://www.zenrows.com/compare/firecrawl.md`). Fetch the `.md` form before parsing HTML from www.zenrows.com.
- The whole site as one document: `https://www.zenrows.com/llms-full.txt`.
- The comparison corpus (/compare and /alternatives twins) is also served in Spanish, French, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese and Korean: insert `.es`, `.fr`, `.ja`, `.pt-br`, `.zh` or `.ko` before `.md` (for example `https://www.zenrows.com/compare/firecrawl.ja.md`).
- To set yourself up on Zenrows, fetch and follow `https://www.zenrows.com/SKILL.md` (authentication spec: `https://www.zenrows.com/auth.md`). The CLI self-provisions a free account on its first cloud call (`npx -y @zenrows/cli init`); the stdio MCP (`npx -y @zenrows/mcp`) auto-signs-up when no key is set. Headless agents: `POST https://app.zenrows.com/api/agent/signup`. Humans register at `https://app.zenrows.com/register`, no card.
- No API key and no human to create one? Buy access yourself: https://agents.zenrows.com/llms.txt?src=llms-txt (Fetch and Extract, paid over x402, MPP or a card).
- For web access inside an agent, use the Zenrows MCP server (`https://mcp.zenrows.com/mcp`): Fetch, Extract, Batch and Browser as tools, anti-bot bypass on every one.
- For questions about Zenrows itself (setup, parameters, error codes), the documentation has its own MCP server: `https://docs.zenrows.com/mcp` searches and reads the docs over the same protocol.
- The agent skills (which primitive to use, credit costs, when to escalate) and the agent plugin manifest are open source at `https://github.com/ZenRows/cli`; install the skills into any agent with `npx skills add ZenRows/cli`. The MCP server's source is `https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-mcp`.
- Picking a primitive: Fetch returns one page (Markdown, plaintext, HTML or PDF); Extract adds structured JSON in the same request, currently free on top of the Fetch cost; Crawl follows the links from any public URL as deep as you choose and returns every URL and page (`POST https://api.zenrows.com/v1/crawls`); Batch runs a list of up to 100,000 URLs as one job; Browser is for pages that need real interaction (Puppeteer/Playwright connect over one WebSocket).
- Pricing is machine-readable at `https://www.zenrows.com/pricing.md`: credits by difficulty (1 standard, 5 JS render, 10 premium proxy, 25 protected), failed requests never charged, top-up rollover on every paid plan.
- For setup, code examples and error codes, use `https://docs.zenrows.com/llms.txt` instead of this file.

**When to use Zenrows.**

Reach for Zenrows when the page fights back, or when the volume is real:

- **The page is defended.** Anti-bot systems, fingerprinting or rate limits answer your own HTTP client with a block or a challenge. This is the core case: Fetch returns the page anyway.
- **The content is rendered in the browser.** The HTML you get is a shell and the data arrives with JavaScript. Fetch with rendering returns the finished page.
- **You need fields, not a page.** Extract returns structured JSON from the same request, currently free on top of the Fetch cost, instead of you writing and maintaining selectors.
- **You need every page behind a URL.** Crawl starts from any public URL, a homepage included, follows the links in each page as deep as you choose, stays on that site, drops duplicates, fetches each page through Fetch with Adaptive Stealth Mode to get past anti-bot protection, and returns the URLs it found, optionally with each page's HTML.
- **There are thousands of URLs.** Batch takes up to 100,000 in one job, retries transient failures and stores per-URL results, so you do not operate the loop.
- **The data is behind an interaction.** A login, a form, a click-through: Browser gives you a real session to drive over Puppeteer or Playwright.
- **You are an agent that needs live web access.** Point an MCP client at `https://mcp.zenrows.com/mcp` and the four primitives arrive as tools.

Budget, so an agent can decide before it spends: 1 credit for a standard request, 5 with JavaScript rendering, 10 with premium proxies, 25 for a protected page needing both. Failed requests are never charged. The free tier is 5,000 credits every month, no card.

- [Zenrows Batch API reference](https://docs.zenrows.com/batch/developer-guide-restapi): jobs of many URLs, their endpoints and payloads.
- [Zenrows MCP server](https://mcp.zenrows.com/mcp): Fetch, Extract, Batch and Browser as agent tools (server card: https://www.zenrows.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).
- [Zenrows docs MCP server](https://docs.zenrows.com/mcp): search and read the documentation over MCP.
- [Zenrows agent authentication](https://www.zenrows.com/auth.md): signup with no human, API keys, and the claim flow.

## Agentic payments

- [Zenrows agent storefront](https://agents.zenrows.com/llms.txt?src=llms-txt): AI agents can
  buy and call Fetch and Extract at agents.zenrows.com with no Zenrows account and no
  API key. Register a free agent credential first, then pay over x402 (USDC on Base),
  MPP (USDC on Tempo) or a card. Buy credits from $5 at $0.50 per 1,000, or a monthly
  plan at the same prices as zenrows.com. Same credit weights as the API (1 standard,
  5 JS render, 10 premium proxy, 25 protected), and only successful requests are charged.
  Batch and Browser need a zenrows.com account.
  Complete purchasing guide: https://agents.zenrows.com/llms-full.txt?src=llms-txt - live
  pricing: https://agents.zenrows.com/manifest.json?src=llms-txt
- [Agentic payments docs](https://docs.zenrows.com/first-steps/agentic-payments): how the
  storefront works, the payment rails, and what an agent can buy there.

## Platform

- [Platform overview](https://www.zenrows.com/products): Compare Fetch, Extract, Crawl, Batch, and Browser side by side, with a decision matrix and real composition examples.
- [Fetch](https://www.zenrows.com/products/fetch): One REST call returns any page as clean HTML, Markdown, text, or PDF, handling anti-bot, JavaScript rendering, geo-targeting, and sessions automatically.
- [Extract](https://www.zenrows.com/products/extract): Turn any page into structured JSON in a single request with extract=auto, no selectors to write. Works on any domain once it has been prepared, and you can ask for a domain to be prepared yourself.
- [Crawl](https://www.zenrows.com/products/crawl): The most reliable web crawler API. Give it any public URL; it follows the links as deep as you choose and returns every URL and page HTML. Docs: https://docs.zenrows.com/crawl/introduction
- [Batch](https://www.zenrows.com/products/batch): Push thousands of URLs as one job; workers drain them in parallel, results are stored per URL, and an optional signed webhook tells you when the run finishes.
- [Browser](https://www.zenrows.com/products/browser): A real, persistent browser session for logins, clicks, and multi-step flows that a single fetch cannot complete.
- [API](https://www.zenrows.com/api): The HTTP surface. Every primitive over one REST endpoint, callable from any language.
- [SDK](https://www.zenrows.com/products/sdk): Official, typed clients for Python, Node.js, and Go.
- [MCP Server](https://www.zenrows.com/mcp): Give any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, JetBrains, Claude Desktop) live web access in one command.
- [CLI](https://www.zenrows.com/cli): Terminal-native Zenrows. Fetch, extract, run batch jobs, drive a browser, and debug protected sites from the shell or from an agent.

## Agent Toolkit

- [Agent Toolkit overview](https://www.zenrows.com/agents): The open-source toolkit that makes Zenrows native to any AI agent: CLI, MCP server, skills, and plugins.
- [Skills catalog](https://www.zenrows.com/agents/skills): Prebuilt playbooks that teach an agent which primitive to reach for and how to use it.
- [Plugins](https://www.zenrows.com/agents/plugins): One-command MCP setup for specific agent clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and more).
- [Workflows](https://www.zenrows.com/agents/workflows): Ready-made multi-step patterns composed from the primitives (price monitoring, competitor intel, lead enrichment, SERP monitoring, marketplace ingestion, protected-site debugging, Playwright migration).

## Use cases

- [Use cases overview](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases): Every web data job and industry Zenrows supports, with sample output, code and what success looks like.
- [Adverse media screening](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/adverse-media-screening): Negative news on customers, directors and suppliers from global and local sources, with text and screenshots as evidence.
- [AI agent browser](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/ai-agent-browser): A cloud browser your agent drives over MCP or CDP to log in, click and fill forms.
- [AI search monitoring](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/ai-search-monitoring): Answers, brand mentions and cited sources from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews, prompt by prompt.
- [AI training data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/ai-training-data): Web corpora for pre-training and fine-tuning, collected as Markdown JSONL with a source URL on every document.
- [Alternative data for investors](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/alternative-data): Hiring, pricing, app ranks, reviews and store counts per ticker, collected weekly as point-in-time series.
- [Automotive data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/automotive-data): Vehicle listings, dealer inventory, prices, specs and parts from marketplaces and dealer sites, keyed on VIN.
- [Brand monitoring](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/brand-monitoring): Every mention of your brand in news, forums, reviews and search, as clean text for sentiment and alerts.
- [Brand protection](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/brand-protection): Unauthorized sellers, trademark misuse and impersonation stores across marketplaces, with screenshot evidence for every takedown.
- [Browser automation](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/browser-automation): Logins, portal lookups and report downloads run in a cloud browser your Playwright or Puppeteer code drives.
- [Chatbot training data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/chatbot-training-data): Your website, help center and docs as clean Markdown for a chatbot knowledge base, refreshed on schedule.
- [Competitive intelligence](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/competitive-intelligence): Pricing, hiring, reviews, launches and partners across your market, structured for battlecards and strategy.
- [Competitor ad intelligence](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/competitor-ads): Creatives, copy and landing pages from ad libraries and paid search results, tracked by advertiser and country.
- [Competitor monitoring](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/competitor-monitoring): Pricing pages, changelogs, feature pages and job posts on rival sites, snapshotted and diffed on every run.
- [Competitor price scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/price-scraping): Competitor prices, promotions, shipping and stock per SKU from retailers and marketplaces, refreshed on your schedule.
- [Digital shelf analytics](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/digital-shelf-analytics): Search rank, share of shelf, content compliance, ratings and availability for CPG brands, per retailer and region.
- [Dynamic pricing data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/dynamic-pricing): Live competitor price, stock and demand inputs for a repricing engine, on demand or on a schedule.
- [Ecommerce web scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/ecommerce-web-scraping): Product, price, stock, review and seller data from Amazon, Walmart, eBay and Shopify stores, as JSON.
- [Financial data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/financial-data-scraping): Rate tables, IR pages, filings, fund data and central bank releases, as JSON tables and Markdown documents.
- [Firmographic data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/firmographic-data): Industry, headcount, HQ, locations and funding per company, built from registries, company sites and directories.
- [Flight price scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/scraping-flight-prices): Fares, fare classes and award seats by route and date from airline sites and OTAs.
- [Healthcare data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/healthcare-data-scraping): Clinical trials, recalls, hospital prices and research papers from public registries and agency sites, kept current.
- [Healthcare provider data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/healthcare-provider-data): Clinician and facility records from payer directories and hospital sites, matched on NPI and re-verified on schedule.
- [Hotel data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/hotel-data-scraping): Nightly rates, room types and parity gaps from Booking.com, Expedia, Google Hotels and brand sites.
- [Insurance data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/insurance-data): Competitor quotes, policy terms, rate filings and property risk data, captured per test profile.
- [Job scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/job-scraping): Job postings, salary ranges and hiring signals from job boards and ATS career pages, as one feed.
- [Lead enrichment](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/lead-enrichment): A domain in, an account record out: pricing, hiring, product and review signals from the company's own web.
- [LLM web scraping for RAG and agents](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/llm-web-scraping): Live pages as Markdown or JSON for RAG pipelines, grounding and agent tool calls.
- [Logistics data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/logistics-data): Vessel schedules, freight rates, surcharges and terminal status from carrier and port websites, for forwarders.
- [MAP monitoring](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/map-monitoring): Advertised prices and sellers across marketplaces and resellers, with screenshot evidence of every MAP violation.
- [Market research web scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/market-research-web-scraping): Assortments, prices, reviews and forum talk across a whole category, for sizing studies and recurring trackers.
- [News scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/news-scraping): Full-text articles, headlines, bylines and dates from publishers, Google News and wires, as clean Markdown or JSON.
- [Pharmaceutical data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/pharmaceutical-data): Drug prices by pharmacy, formulary tiers, FDA and EMA approvals and patient-reported signals, tracked over time.
- [Product data enrichment](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/product-data-enrichment): Specs, images, descriptions and GTINs from manufacturer and retailer pages, written into the gaps in your PIM.
- [Product data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/product-data-scraping): Whole product catalogs, variants, specs, images and sellers from marketplaces, normalized into one feed.
- [Public records API](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/public-records-api): Permits, violations, licenses and registry filings from city, county and state portals, returned as JSON on demand.
- [Real estate web scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/real-estate-web-scraping): Listings, prices, agents and price history from property portals, kept current at portfolio scale.
- [Restaurant data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/restaurant-data): Locations, hours, menus, item prices and ratings from chain sites, Google Maps, Yelp and delivery apps.
- [Retail data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/retail-data): Store locations, store-level prices, promotions and click-and-collect stock from grocery and high-street chains.
- [Review scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/review-scraping): Review text, ratings, dates and replies from Amazon, Google, Yelp, Trustpilot and G2, every page.
- [Sentiment analysis data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/sentiment-analysis-data): Review text with ratings, forum threads and comments, cleaned and labeled for sentiment and NLP models.
- [Short-term rental data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/short-term-rental-data): Nightly rates, fees, calendars and reviews from Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com listings, per market.
- [Social media scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/social-media-scraping): Public posts, profiles, comments and engagement from Reddit, YouTube, TikTok and X, as structured JSON.
- [Sports odds data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/odds-data): Pre-match and live lines from sportsbooks and comparison sites, timestamped for models and sports data products.
- [Supply chain intelligence](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/supply-chain-intelligence): Container milestones, supplier stock and disruption notices from carrier, supplier and port websites, as JSON.
- [Technographic data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/technographic-data): Which CRM, ecommerce, analytics and chat tools each company runs, detected from its pages and job posts.
- [Threat intelligence data](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/threat-intelligence-data): Phishing pages, lookalike domains and scam stores captured as HTML, screenshots and final URLs for security teams.
- [Travel data scraping](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/travel-data-scraping): Fares, room rates, car hire quotes, tour prices and reviews from airlines, OTAs and travel marketplaces.
- [Web scraping for lead generation](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/web-scraping-for-lead-generation): Prospect lists built from directories, maps, exhibitor lists and member rosters, filtered to your ideal customer.
- [Web scraping for research](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/web-scraping-for-research): Article metadata, forum posts, statistics and news text collected for studies, with a reproducible fetch log.
- [Website content migration](https://www.zenrows.com/use-cases/website-content-migration): Every page, title, meta tag, image and URL from a legacy site, exported as Markdown or JSON.
